items.source:
Return the root object to be exposed by the extension. It's strongly recommended to declare the most concrete type
possible as return type of the implementation method. This will allow us to obtain the necessary metadata once and
not for every evaluation.
items.translation: 返回扩展要暴露的根对象。强烈建议将实现方法的返回类型声明为最具体的类型。这样我们只需获取一次必要的元数据，而无需在每次评估时都获取。
托马斯·达里蒙特，奥利弗·吉尔克

items.source: the root object to be exposed by the extension.
SPI to allow adding a set of properties and function definitions accessible via the root of an EvaluationContext provided by an ExtensionAwareEvaluationContextProvider.
items.translation: SPI 允许添加一组属性和函数定义，这些可通过由 ExtensionAwareEvaluationContextProvider 提供的 EvaluationContext 的根节点进行访问。
